Subject: Bridgewater — control intake & owner confirmation for SIG/SOC2 packet

Hi Samir —

Thanks for the RFP submission last week. To keep the SIG + SOC 2 intake moving, we want to confirm a tight plan for collecting evidence and mapping control ownership. Attached is a blank Bridgewater_SIG_Template.xlsx that mirrors the standard SIG layout we use and an initial proposed access window PDF.

High-level asks:
- Can you confirm the internal owner(s) for the controls listed in tab "Control_Roster" by EOD Thu 14 Jun? We need a named point of contact per control (name + title + email).
- For evidence delivery, we prefer a shared Drive folder (link below) and a short index file per artifact (filename, system, date range, rationale).
- If any control requires live access (screenshare or read-only console access), please flag it in column G of the template and propose an availability window.

Timeline we propose:
1) Ownership confirmation + filled template: by 14 Jun
2) Artifacts for Priority 1 controls: by 18 Jun
3) Remaining artifacts: rolling, complete by 25 Jun

Notes on formats and minimal acceptability: DOC/PDF exported reports, CSV audit extracts (with column headers), screenshots with timestamps, and role-based access lists are fine. For anything we need to validate live (e.g., privileged session logs), we can schedule a short read-only session.

Drive: https://drive.company.com/shared/bridgewater-evidence
Request portal: https://app.redwood.com/requests/BRG-4521

Attachments: Bridgewater_SIG_Template.xlsx, access-window-schedule.pdf

Appreciate confirmation of owners and whether the timeline looks reasonable. I can coordinate with procurement (cc'd) if you need a PO/contract reference.

Best,
Ethan Park
Senior Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference

Samir — thanks. Short answers:
1) For scoping, please include a simple system inventory (name, owner, business function) for any system that maps to an in-scope control. That helps us tie logs/exports to controls during review. A one-sheet CSV is sufficient.
2) Zipped exports are OK — password-protected is fine; please share the password via a separate channel (email to my direct + phone text).

Procurement blurb (one sentence): "Redwood Inference will perform control evidence intake, mapping, and verification activities to support Bridgewater Analytics' SIG and SOC 2 response for the 2028 RFP process."

Process notes and clarifications we will follow:
- We'll mark items Priority 1 (evidence required to validate SOC 2 in-scope controls and high-risk SIG rows).
- For Priority 1 items, target 5 business day turnaround once we confirm owners.
- If live validation is required, we will request a max 90-minute read-only session and provide step-by-step instructions for the scope.

Laura and Karthik, looping you to confirm the internal intake checklist and to ask whether we should request any special exports from the logging platform (sumologic vs internal ELK).

Ethan
